entities.summary: Maxim Kaibkhanovich Dadashev was a Russian boxer who competed in the light-welterweight (63.5 kg) division. A participant of the 2015 European Games, Dadashev was a Russian amateur champion. Born in Leningrad, Soviet Union, he was of Lezgin descent.
